title: Split Realm Beetle Deity
description: A highly detailed surreal ink illustration split vertically down the center. The left side features a bright white background with line-drawn beetles and celestial motifs, while the right side has a solid black background with glowing orbs and smoke; a large multi-armed beetle god wearing a crown of golden rings stands atop a pile of broken beetles and rubble at the dividing line, holding various occult symbols.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal black and white ink drawing split vertically into light and dark realms, a massive multi-armed beetle deity with a crown of golden rings stands at the center atop a pile of crushed beetles and rubble, holding various occult symbols like rings and crosses, left side shows bright white background with floating beetles and starbursts, right side shows black background with glowing orbs and swirling smoke, intricate linework, symbolic and mystical atmosphere
medium: pen and ink with gold accents
